# Maven build output target/
# Git and IDE files .git/ .gitignore .idea/ .vscode/ *.iml *.classpath *.project *.settings/
# Logs *.log logs/
# Environment / secrets (never bake into image) .env .env.*
# CI/CD files (not needed inside container) Jenkinsfile .compose_cmd
# Documentation HELP.md README.md
# OS metadata .DS_Store Thumbs.db

option.name: updatedContent
option.value:
# Multi-stage build for InvestIQ Spring Boot application (Java 17) FROM maven:3.9.9-eclipse-temurin-17 AS build WORKDIR /workspace
# Download dependencies first (layer cache optimization) COPY pom.xml ./ RUN mvn -B dependency:go-offline
# Build the application COPY src ./src RUN mvn -B clean package -DskipTests
# --- Runtime image --- FROM eclipse-temurin:17-jre-alpine WORKDIR /app
# Create a non-root user for security RUN addgroup -S investiq && adduser -S investiq -G investiq
COPY --from=build /workspace/target/*.jar app.jar RUN chown investiq:investiq app.jar
USER investiq EXPOSE 8083
HEALTHCHECK --interval=30s --timeout=10s --start-period=60s --retries=5 \ CMD wget -qO- http://localhost:8083/v3/api-docs >/dev/null || exit 1
ENTRYPOINT ["java", "-XX:+UseContainerSupport", "-XX:MaxRAMPercentage=75.0", "-jar", "app.jar"]

services: mysql: image: mysql:8.0 container_name: investiq-mysql restart: unless-stopped environment: MYSQL_ROOT_PASSWORD: ${MYSQL_ROOT_PASSWORD:-root123} MYSQL_DATABASE: ${MYSQL_DATABASE:-investiq} MYSQL_USER: ${MYSQL_USER:-investiq_user} MYSQL_PASSWORD: ${MYSQL_PASSWORD:-investiq_password} ports: - "${MYSQL_PORT:-3306}:3306" volumes: - mysql_data:/var/lib/mysql healthcheck: test: ["CMD", "mysqladmin", "ping", "-h", "localhost", "-u", "root", "-p${MYSQL_ROOT_PASSWORD:-root123}"] interval: 10s timeout: 5s retries: 15 start_period: 30s networks: - investiq-network
app: build: context: . dockerfile: Dockerfile container_name: investiq-app restart: unless-stopped depends_on: mysql: condition: service_healthy environment: SERVER_PORT: ${SERVER_PORT:-8083} SPRING_APPLICATION_NAME: InvestIQ SPRING_DATASOURCE_URL: jdbc:mysql://mysql:3306/${MYSQL_DATABASE:-investiq}?allowPublicKeyRetrieval=true&useSSL=false SPRING_DATASOURCE_USERNAME: ${MYSQL_USER:-investiq_user} SPRING_DATASOURCE_PASSWORD: ${MYSQL_PASSWORD:-investiq_password} SPRING_DATASOURCE_DRIVER_CLASS_NAME: com.mysql.cj.jdbc.Driver SPRING_SQL_INIT_MODE: always # Finnhub market data API MARKET_API_URL: ${MARKET_API_URL:-https://finnhub.io/api/v1} MARKET_API_KEY: ${MARKET_API_KEY:-} # Alpha Vantage API ALPHA_VANTAGE_BASE_URL: ${ALPHA_VANTAGE_BASE_URL:-https://www.alphavantage.co/query} ALPHA_VANTAGE_API_KEY: ${ALPHA_VANTAGE_API_KEY:-} # Twelve Data API TWELVE_DATA_BASE_URL: ${TWELVE_DATA_BASE_URL:-https://api.twelvedata.com} TWELVE_DATA_API_KEY: ${TWELVE_DATA_API_KEY:-} ports: - "${APP_PORT:-8083}:8083" healthcheck: test: ["CMD-SHELL", "wget -qO- http://localhost:8083/v3/api-docs >/dev/null || exit 1"] interval: 30s timeout: 10s retries: 5 start_period: 90s networks: - investiq-network
volumes: mysql_data: driver: local
networks: investiq-network: driver: bridge
